question: For LAM customers who use EUR, identify those whose monthly consumption in 2013 exceeded the average monthly consumption of all EUR-using customers in that same year. Return each qualifying customer’s ID along with the specific year-month (e.g., '201306') when their consumption surpassed this average.

),

    SELECT AVG(monthly_consumption) AS avg_monthly_consumption

FROM eur_2013 AS e

WHERE e.customer_id IN (
    SELECT c.XCL_001

    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'LAM'

  AND e.monthly_consumption > a.avg_monthly_consumption

)

ORDER BY mc.CustomerID, mc.YearMonth
